- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for consecutive high sentiment days.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >85% of 30d high) — add 3–8% buffer to prevent premature correction.
- Overshoot in early forecast horizon (days 1–7) — apply 10–15% downward adjustment if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- Mean-reversion bias in mid-horizon (days 8–15) — if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10%.
- Lagged sentiment decay: if sentiment drops below 0.5 after day 10, reduce forecast slope by 20–30% to avoid overcorrection.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment + high recent price — cap forecast at 10% below 30d high if sentiment > 0.85 and price > 80.00.
